**Milestone — Machine learning against the linear baseline.** [What makes it good](../milestones.qmd#m238)

::: {.why}
The milestone you are most at risk of doing well and concluding too much from, which is why it is graded on the interval and the provenance rather than on which model won.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Present a conclusion that is a number with an interval, reported the same way it would have been in the other direction.
- Show the linear baseline was tuned as carefully as the alternative, with evidence rather than assertion.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Assemble reports/milestone-07-ml.md: the labelling scheme and why, purged and embargoed validation with the embargo justified from measured autocorrelation, the linear baseline with its tuning shown, the audit table with intervals and seed spreads, permutation importance with the proxy analysis, and the verdict.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Verify: rerun the audit from the committed configuration and confirm every number matches, then check the provenance notes are still accurate after a week of work.
:::
:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, thirty-fourth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications and the sevenths.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The whole machine learning round, compressed: bias and variance, regularisation, cross-validation on dependent data, and why more capacity does not help at low signal-to-noise. Four answers, ninety seconds each, out loud, against a clock.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Research presentation, third sitting: expand to two minutes, and this time include one number with its uncertainty. Time it. The number with the uncertainty is what makes a quantitative audience trust the rest.
:::
:::

## The running strategy

::: {.project}
Milestone 7 closes the machine learning phase. The ML layer either joins the book with a stated marginal contribution or does not join it, and either outcome is recorded with the interval that produced the decision.
:::
